payload.title: No automatic code moves a mission out of MAIN_VERIFYING (OUTCOME_OBSERVING, VERIFIED and FAILED_AND_ROLLED_BACK have no producer), and MAIN_VERIFYING holds the single WIP slot, so the first merged mission-bound PR blocks every later mission selection (latent: no mission-bound PR exists yet)
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/mission_reconcile.py:330-357 (a merged PR moves a mission into MAIN_VERIFYING and is silent from there on)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/mission_reconcile.py:305-316 (the only unattended transition_mission call of the reconciler)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/mission.py:142-155 (MAIN_VERIFYING is an active WIP state and the cap is 1)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/mission.py:242-247 (the edges out of MAIN_VERIFYING and OUTCOME_OBSERVING exist but nothing walks them)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/mission_scheduler.py:338-346 (a held slot returns WIP_SLOT_HELD for every other mission)
payload.rule_violated: ORPHAN-HIGH-544 closed the entry half of the merge tail; the state machine's exit half (verified or failed-and-rolled-back) has no producer, so a declared edge table is not walked.
payload.notes: A mission bound to a PR (the ARIA-Mission trailer) whose PR merges is moved to MAIN_VERIFYING with a ci_status wake key that nothing reads. Because MAIN_VERIFYING is in ACTIVE_WIP_STATES, select_next_mission returns WIP_SLOT_HELD for every open mission until an operator runs mission transition by hand. Latent today: the audit found no mission-bound PR, so the trap has not fired. Close condition: mission_reconcile gains an outcome step (VERIFIED on a green post-merge CI row plus a change_outcome row, FAILED_AND_ROLLED_BACK on a landed revert) and a test records a merged mission-bound PR and asserts the mission leaves MAIN_VERIFYING within a stated number of cycles so that select_next_mission no longer returns WIP_SLOT_HELD for it (red today). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
